chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'If he finds only one man or two men for the expiation, he should repeat [the payment] to them until he completes ten; he gives them [the payment] today, then gives them [again] tomorrow.'
ai.seo_question: How to fulfill the expiation if there are fewer than ten poor people available?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this chain linking Imam al-Sadiq to Imam Ali, establishing the permissibility of aggregating the required ten poor persons by feeding the same individuals on consecutive days. This ruling provides practical flexibility for those with limited resources, ensuring the spiritual obligation of *kaffarah* is met even when the pool of eligible recipients is small, while maintaining the integrity of the ten-person requirement.
